title: Letter of resignation of a director
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Corporate Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every section of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 cited.

parts.why: The director's name and address, then the date. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Addressed to the company secretary. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The salutation. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The subject heading. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
I write to resign my appointment as a director of the company with effect from {{effectiveDate}}. The company documents in my possession will be handed over to the company secretary.

I appreciate the opportunity given to me to serve the company.
parts.why: The resignation, when it takes effect, and the handing over of company documents. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Signed by the director. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
